name: gob.mx
body: A permanent https redirect, real 404s for unknown paths, and pages that read well without JavaScript. But the start page sends no X-Frame-Options, no CSP frame-ancestors, and no HSTS, so any site can load it in a frame.
lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in a CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN. It stops clickjacking on forms.
summary: www.gob.mx scores 64 out of 100 (D). 3 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 13 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 9 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 2 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /publicaciones answered 404, linked from /que-es-gobmx, /accesibilidad and 2 more. /ciberseguridad answered 404, linked from /terminos.
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /index.xhtml. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: INGRESS_STICKY, JSESSIONID, _session_id. Without HttpOnly: JSESSIONID. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /index.xhtml, /terminos and 1 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 9 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on 3 of 9 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 566 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
